research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance, evidence ordering, and distractor content to assess answer consistency in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer errors across paraphrased queries, separating retrieval failures from unsupported generation through manual review of retrieved passages and responses.

research.title: Calibration and Abstention for Intent Classification Under Domain Shift
bullets: Designed cross-domain experiments comparing classifier calibration and abstention strategies under shifts in intent frequency and vocabulary.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, selective prediction curves, and confusion patterns to characterize relationships between confidence errors and minority-intent performance.

publications.title: Confidence Under Domain Shift: Calibration and Selective Prediction for Intent Classification
Intent Frequency and Vocabulary Shift: An Empirical Analysis of Classifier Confidence

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Neural Sequence Taggers
bullets: Implemented token-independent and recurrent sequence tagging baselines in PyTorch, using shared preprocessing and consistent training partitions for named entity recognition.
Compared entity-level precision and recall across entity categories, inspecting boundary errors and predictions involving words absent from training data.

projects.title: Lexical and Neural Baselines for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented term-weighted logistic regression and pooled word-embedding classifiers, evaluating both approaches with matched data partitions and preprocessing choices.
Compared classification errors across review lengths and negation patterns, examining how vocabulary filtering affected lexical and neural model behavior.
